text:
Both summaries are accurate on the key numbers: 2,391 of 4,812 failed, 1,940 retried and bought, 451 did not, an estimated $41,900 lost, and 312 support contacts at about four times normal. Both also give the cause, the slow detection and the follow-up actions.

The main difference is the 120-word limit. Response A comes to about 124 words, slightly over. Response B comes to about 160, well over. B also has filler ("To show the scale of the incident, here is its impact", "Following the incident, the following actions...") and a bulleted action list that adds little for a busy manager.

On content, B names connector B and the August renewal, which is a little more specific on root cause. A covers the same ground more briefly and adds the 11:35 support escalation time. A also folds the open actions into one line with their due dates.

A is more concise and closer to the limit, with no accuracy cost.

Verdict: A
